description: This is a Java unit test for the class NonEmptyValueValidator, testing validation behavior of header values, including null checks, immutability, and empty value rejection.

classes.name: NonEmptyValueValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for NonEmptyValueValidator, validating header value checks.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test instance of NonEmptyValueValidator before each test.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Verifies that accepting a null header definition throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Verifies that accepting a null value throws DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Checks that a valid non-empty string passes validation without exceptions.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsValueIsEmpty
